$comment: FE-F2 brand asset manifest. Every file records its frozen source coordinate and SHA-256; scripts/check-assets.mjs verifies the working tree still matches. Legacy sources: Yearning@e5b7e00 (backend), gemini-next@c00ed5d (frontend), shadcndashboard@6f99c0b (template). The legacy repositories are reference-only; no runtime or build path points into them.
dedupe_decision: Two encodings of the Yearning logo exist in the legacy sources: backend img/logo.jpeg (sha256 46f583ab638f86fc995776d8422f78de58edca7319638440c5d4212594c92168, 27562 B) and frontend login page src/assets/login/logo.jpeg (b2bf2217db473abddd45a2e11995ef99b5c3c5e6ec8b72e678572d7365acb719, 30129 B). Per the FE-F0 asset inventory the frontend login-page set is the one users actually saw; exactly one set is carried and the backend encoding is recorded here only to document the dedupe decision. No other duplicate-by-content files exist between public/ and src/assets/.

review.accessibility: Both wordmark variants carry decorative-image treatment (alt text + adjacent product name text) so the logo is never the sole carrier of the product name.
